blurb: See Lake Tahoe at it's most spectacular- lit up by the setting sun! Leave the crowds of tourists behind as top-rated guide company,Tahoe Outdoor Adventures takes you off-the-beaten-path. Experienced guides combine hiking and photography into one jaw dropping adventure. Hike, climb, and explore giant boulders on top of this 360 degree view of Lake Tahoe during this golden hour. Your creative guide will take photos of you!! Bring your camera or cell phone and take your own photos of the endless lake views as the setting sun illuminates the sky. This moderately challenging two hour trek will provide breathtaking sunset views that you will not find on your own. Romantic getaways, families and group outings will please everyone. Go at your own pace while your guide leads the way. Let us show your our favorite hidden treasures of the area & feel free to reach out if your date is unavailable! Everyone has the option for an easy, moderate or challenging hike. Enjoy a nice small group size.
